figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 1. Phylogenetic tree of extant taxane hydroxylases and other homologous CYP725A subfamily sequences. The rooted maximum likelihood
tree constructed in MEGA7 was used for ancestral reconstruction (bootstrap values shown). The scale of 0.1 is the genetic distance. Ancestral
nodes of T5αOH (A1, A2, A3, and A4) are marked with red dots. The extant taxane hydroxylases, which derived from the Taxus among the
descendant nodes, were bold and italicized.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 2. Intracellular fermentation transformation of taxadiene to monoxygenated taxanes. (A) GC analysis of the products of the dodecane layer.
Compounds are taxa-4(5),11(12)-diene, 14.75 min; iso-OCT (1), 15.98 min; diterpenoid1 (2), 16.15 min; OCT (3), 16.47 min; T-5α-ol (4),
16.74 min; and internal standard n-octadecane, 11.45 min; (B) Quantitative analysis of monooxygenated taxanes. All experiments were performed
in triplicate, and error bars indicate standard deviation (SD).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 3. Structure-based sequence alignment of A1, A2, A3, A4, and T5αOH. Numbers refer to the positions of residues in the A1 sequence.
Conserved secondary structural elements α-helices (coils labeled α1−18) and β-strands (unlabeled arrows) based on the structures of A1 are
marked above the sequences. Residues highlighted in red are identical across all five proteins. Residues in white mean that there exists a difference
in the five sequences. The alignment was rendered using the ESPript 3.0 server.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 4. (A) Homologous model of T5αOH, α-helix6 was marked in yellow, and two mutation sites were marked in red; (B) specific yield of
monooxygenated products and taxadiene using engineered E. coli. All seven mutation sites were distributed on α-helix6. All experiments were
performed in triplicate, and error bars indicate ± standard deviation (SD). Statistically significant differences between mutants and wild type were
determined using Student’s t-test. *p < 0.05; **p < 0.01 relative to T5αOH.
